g.text: Meridian Platform -- End-to-End System Trace (Whole System)
One Weather Reading from Field Station GUELPH to Console
(frame -> ingest -> store -> orchestrator -> model -> output -> parser -> store -> API -> console)
2. Divides integer channels by 100.0 to restore physical units
[Data Format: SQL text stream via pipe]
INSERT OR REPLACE INTO reading (stnid, year, doy, tmax, tmin, rain, srad, rh, wind, flags)
SELECT doy, tmax, tmin, rain, srad FROM reading WHERE stnid='GUELPH' AND year=2025 ORDER BY doy;
2. Retrieves soil/latitude parameters for GUELPH (AWC=0.15, depth=1100mm)
2. Subroutine WATBAL: Simulates snowpack, runoff, PET, cascading 5-layer soil water
3. Subroutine GROWTH: Simulates thermal time, leaf expansion (LAI), biomass & grain yield
Write daily and seasonal simulation output
- Line 1 (Header): MERIDIAN CROPMOD V2.3 STN=GUELPH YEAR=2025 NDAYS= 180
- Line 2 (Labels): DOY SW ET DRAIN BIOM LAI
[Data Format: Local ASCII file path in scratch directory]
Read lines and apply column slicing
Fixed-column slice extraction (avoids whitespace overflow split bugs):
[Data Format: Parameterized SQL INSERT via sqlite3]
- INSERT OR REPLACE INTO forecast VALUES ('GUELPH', 2025, '2025-05-01T04:00:00', 6.425, 180, 'cropmod V2.3');
- INSERT OR REPLACE INTO forecast_daily VALUES ('GUELPH', 2025, 120, 182.40, 2.150, 0.000, 120.5, 0.450);
[Data Format: HTTP GET Request / URL Query Parameters]
Dispatches worker thread from fixed pool (8 threads).
Spawns sqlite3 child process to query reading store.
[Data Format: JSON Array String over pipe]
- dashboard (jQuery $.ajax): Injects values into HTML table and <div> bar charts
- ui-next (React fetch): Binds typed series to SVG line chart (SeriesChart.tsx)
[Data Format: HTML DOM Table Row & SVG Coordinate Path]
